note: Deep-dive #11. Needs the second Entra tenant 'Northwind Lab' (riley.demo) created by the owner beforehand. Tokens used by isolation and limits are fetched in prepare (device code, owner signs in) and live in environment variables only; they expire after about an hour, so record the screens in one go. Order: tokens, isolation, rls, limits.
prepare: dotnet test tests/TenantApi.Tests -m:1
Invoke-Pester ./tests
# owner signs in (device code), not recorded
az login --use-device-code
$env:MG_LAB_TENANT = az account show --query tenantId -o tsv
$env:MG_NW_TENANT = Read-Host 'Northwind Lab tenant ID (owner types, never recorded)'
./scripts/New-SaasApps.ps1 -WhatIf
$ids = ./scripts/New-SaasApps.ps1
$env:MG_API_CLIENT = $ids.ApiClientId; $env:MG_CLI_CLIENT = $ids.CliClientId
az ad sp create --id $ids.ApiClientId; az ad sp create --id $ids.CliClientId
# manual: Enterprise applications > contoso-saas-api > Users and groups: assign labadmin to Platform administrator; contoso-saas-cli > Permissions: Grant admin consent for the lab tenant
Import-Module ./scripts/SaasLab.psm1 -Force
Get-AdminConsentUrl -CustomerTenantId $env:MG_NW_TENANT -CliClientId $ids.CliClientId -ApiClientId $ids.ApiClientId   # open in a private window as the Northwind admin and accept (owner)
az group create -n rg-mglab-deep-dive-11 -l westeurope -o none

$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-11 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p "apiClientId=$($ids.ApiClientId)" "homeTenantId=$($env:MG_LAB_TENANT)" "sqlAdminLogin=$(az ad signed-in-user show --query userPrincipalName -o tsv)" "sqlAdminObjectId=$(az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv)" --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json
$env:MG_WEB11_URL = "https://$($o.webAppHostName.value)"; $env:MG_SQL11 = $o.sqlServerFqdn.value; $env:MG_WEBAPP11 = $o.webAppName.value

$ip = Invoke-RestMethod https://api.ipify.org; az sql server firewall-rule create -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-11 -s ($env:MG_SQL11.Split('.')[0]) -n laptop --start-ip-address $ip --end-ip-address $ip -o none

# manual: SSMS (Entra MFA, labadmin) database tenants: run 001-schema.sql, 002-rls.sql, then 003-grant-app.sql in SQLCMD mode with :setvar AppIdentity <web app name>; verify-rls.sql must give 2 / 1 / 0 and error 33504
dotnet publish src/TenantApi -c Release -o publish; Compress-Archive -Path publish/* -DestinationPath app.zip -Force
az webapp deploy -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-11 -n $env:MG_WEBAPP11 --src-path app.zip --type zip
(Invoke-WebRequest "$($env:MG_WEB11_URL)/healthz").Content

$env:MG_TOK_ADMIN = Get-DeviceCodeToken -TenantId $env:MG_LAB_TENANT -ClientId $env:MG_CLI_CLIENT -Scope "api://$($env:MG_API_CLIENT)/Requests.ReadWrite" -Label 'labadmin'   # owner signs in as labadmin

Invoke-SaasApi -BaseUrl $env:MG_WEB11_URL -Path "/admin/tenants/$env:MG_LAB_TENANT" -Method PUT -Token $env:MG_TOK_ADMIN -Body @{ name = 'Adventure Works'; plan = 'starter' } | Select-Object Status   # expect 201

$env:MG_TOK_ALEX = Get-DeviceCodeToken -TenantId $env:MG_LAB_TENANT -ClientId $env:MG_CLI_CLIENT -Scope "api://$($env:MG_API_CLIENT)/Requests.ReadWrite" -Label 'alex.demo'   # owner signs in as alex.demo

$env:MG_TOK_SAM = Get-DeviceCodeToken -TenantId $env:MG_LAB_TENANT -ClientId $env:MG_CLI_CLIENT -Scope "api://$($env:MG_API_CLIENT)/Requests.ReadWrite" -Label 'sam.demo'   # owner signs in as sam.demo

$env:MG_TOK_NW = Get-DeviceCodeToken -TenantId $env:MG_NW_TENANT -ClientId $env:MG_CLI_CLIENT -Scope "api://$($env:MG_API_CLIENT)/Requests.ReadWrite" -Label 'riley.demo'   # owner signs in as riley.demo in Northwind Lab

screens.name: tokens
commands: Get-TokenClaims $aw | Select-Object tid, iss, scp, ver
Get-TokenClaims $nw | Select-Object tid, iss, scp, ver
also: The owner completes both device-code sign-ins on camera (alex.demo in the lab tenant, riley.demo in Northwind Lab); the code and URL may be shown, the tokens never are.

screens.name: isolation
prepare: sqlcmd -S $env:MG_SQL11 -d tenants -G -b -Q "EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context N'TenantId', N'$env:MG_NW_TENANT'; DELETE dbo.PurchaseRequests; DELETE dbo.Tenants WHERE TenantId = '$env:MG_NW_TENANT';"   # owner signs in (Entra); makes the first /me a 401 again
sqlcmd -S $env:MG_SQL11 -d tenants -G -b -Q "EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context N'TenantId', N'$env:MG_LAB_TENANT'; DELETE dbo.PurchaseRequests;"
az webapp restart -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-11 -n $env:MG_WEBAPP11; Start-Sleep -Seconds 45   # the app caches catalog lookups for 30 s
commands: Invoke-SaasApi -BaseUrl $u -Path "/admin/tenants/$env:MG_NW_TENANT" -Method PUT -Token $admin -Body @{ name = 'Northwind Traders'; plan = 'business' } | Select-Object Status
Invoke-SaasApi -BaseUrl $u -Path /requests -Method POST -Token $nw -Body @{ title = 'Northwind scanners'; amount = 800 } | Select-Object Status
Invoke-SaasApi -BaseUrl $u -Path /requests -Method POST -Token $aw -Body @{ title = 'Adventure Works laptops'; amount = 2400 } | Select-Object Status
Invoke-SaasApi -BaseUrl $u -Path "/admin/tenants/$env:MG_NW_TENANT" -Method PUT -Token $admin -Body @{ name = 'Northwind Traders'; plan = 'business'; status = 'suspended' } | Select-Object Status
Invoke-SaasApi -BaseUrl $u -Path "/admin/tenants/$env:MG_NW_TENANT" -Method PUT -Token $admin -Body @{ name = 'Northwind Traders'; plan = 'business'; status = 'active' } | Select-Object Status
also: Expected statuses in order: 401, 201, 200, 201, 201, 201, rows 2 and 1, 404, rows 1, 403 after suspending (the status change is cached for 30 s, hence the sleep), 201 on re-activation. The web app host is held in $env:MG_WEB11_URL and never printed.

screens.name: rls
steps: Connect to the SQL server (Microsoft Entra MFA as labadmin), database tenants
Run: EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context N'TenantId', '<Northwind tenant id>'; SELECT Title, TenantId FROM dbo.PurchaseRequests;  (2 rows)
Same with the Adventure Works tenant id (1 row)
Open sql/verify-rls.sql and run it: result sets A 2, B 1, none 0, and the cross-tenant insert failing with error 33504
mask: server name in the title bar, Object Explorer and connection dialog

screens.name: limits
prepare: sqlcmd -S $env:MG_SQL11 -d tenants -G -b -Q "EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context N'TenantId', N'$env:MG_LAB_TENANT'; DELETE dbo.PurchaseRequests;"   # start the starter-plan count from zero
Start-Sleep -Seconds 65   # quiet minute for the fixed rate window
commands: 1..26 | ForEach-Object { Invoke-SaasApi -BaseUrl $u -Path /requests -Method POST -Token $alex -Body @{ title = "Request $_"; amount = 100 } } | Select-Object Status, @{ n = 'Detail'; e = { $_.Body.title } }
1..35 | ForEach-Object { $t = if ($_ % 2) { $alex } else { $sam }; Invoke-SaasApi -BaseUrl $u -Path /me -Token $t } | Select-Object Status
also: Expected: 201 x25 then 409 'Plan limit reached' on the 26th; after the pause, 200s until the tenant's 30 calls per minute are used, then 429; the business-plan tenant still gets 200.

teardown: az ad app delete --id $env:MG_API_CLIENT; az ad app delete --id $env:MG_CLI_CLIENT

Remove-Item Env:MG_TOK_ADMIN, Env:MG_TOK_ALEX, Env:MG_TOK_SAM, Env:MG_TOK_NW, Env:MG_WEB11_URL, Env:MG_SQL11, Env:MG_WEBAPP11, Env:MG_LAB_TENANT, Env:MG_NW_TENANT, Env:MG_API_CLIENT, Env:MG_CLI_CLIENT -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
